title: What we will and won't generate: sloth bear
storyboard: Generate (AI, labelled): flat diagram of a sloth bear's front-tooth gap; no realistic animal footage
caption:
Real behaviour, real photos. AI only for the diagram.

Sloth bears are the only bears that routinely carry their young on their backs; cubs ride on a shaggy 'saddle' of fur until about 6 to 9 months old.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo. Tooth diagram: AI-generated (labelled).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
